name: Learning Binary Search
title: F. Learning Binary Search
input_spec:
Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t (1≤t≤104). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains two integers n and m (3≤n,m≤106).

It is guaranteed that the sum of n does not exceed 106 over all test cases, and the sum of m does not exceed 106 over all test cases.
output_spec: For each test case, output the requested sum modulo 676767677 on a new line.
note: In the first test case, one good array a is [2,2,3]. Here, f(a,1,1,n)=0 (as 1 is not present in a), f(a,2,1,n)=1, f(a,3,1,n)=2. Therefore, the contribution of this good array is 0+1+2=3.
